pattern: ばそれまでだ / たらそれまでだ
aliases: ba sore made da / tara sore made da
purpose: Say that if a crucial condition fails, everything ends there.
keywords: Conditional ば / たら + それまでだ
If the secret gets out, it is all over.
Once we lose trust, that is the end of it.
You could simply dismiss it as a lie, but I saw it.
formation: Conditional ば / たら + それまでだ
restrictions: The condition makes further effort or argument pointless.
mistake: It is stronger than merely saying something will be difficult.
